status: Complete: all 24 static renders, six-pose native animation sheets, and full-size encoded 3.5-second midpoint frames visually inspected.
authorshipDisclosure: This reviewer independently reviewed the twenty anatomy/face assets and authored the four story assets 105232–105235. The four story entries are self-review, not independent authorship review.
method: Full-size static renders inspected for every ID; repaired renders re-opened; six-pose sheets at 0, 0.8, 1.4, 3.5, 5.5 and 6.8 seconds inspected for every ID; decoded MP4 midpoint at 3.5 seconds opened at 1200 by 900 for every ID. This is sampled frame inspection, not continuous encoded movie playback review.
visualStandard: Accepted as sparse Hairline-inspired organic line illustration: restrained monochrome hierarchy, coherent silhouettes and contacts, a single focal emphasis, and no noisy paint tracing. This is not photorealism, tonal relighting, or certification against Hairline's isometric kernel.
overall: All 24 accepted within the stated sparse line-illustration and restrained-motion scope. No remaining material silhouette, attachment, clipping, contact, or encoded line-clarity defect found in inspected frames after targeted repairs. Technical checks support export integrity but are not the basis of this artistic judgment.
limitations: Subpixel non-scaling lines lose contrast in downsampled raster contact sheets; assess original-size SVG/film for line clarity.
Anatomy is illustrative and not medically validated.
Lighting is represented by stroke hierarchy rather than physically shaded volume.
Three feature studies animate only stroke emphasis; expression studies hold their expression.
